list.name: seats
list.label: Paid seats
list.description: How many seats you pay for. Typed, not measured.

list.name: seat_cost
list.label: $ per seat, monthly
list.description: Licence cost per seat per month, in dollars. Typed, not measured.

list.name: hourly_rate
list.label: $ per developer hour
list.description: Fully loaded cost of one developer hour — salary plus employer taxes, benefits, equipment and overhead, typically 1.3–1.8× base. Base = salary ÷ ~2,000 h; loaded ≈ base × 1.4 if nobody has the real figure. For a consultancy, use the billable rate. Loaded, not base: a saved hour returns the whole cost of that hour, and a base rate makes break-even look harder than it is.

list.name: hours_per_month
list.label: Working hours per month
list.description: Hours a developer works in a month, typed. Only the conditional ROI uses it: it turns a percentage output difference into hours. 160 is a 40-hour week; use your own.

list.name: contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1
list.label: Contributor

list.name: team
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(wt.team_name, NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(wt.team_name, NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = r.contributor
UNION SELECT '(unassigned)', '(unassigned)'
) options ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

options.content:
Every dollar on this page is a number you typed, multiplied by a number we measured

The tool does not know what you pay, what an hour costs, or how many seats you bought. Those are the boxes at the top of the page — change them and everything below recomputes. Token prices are not typed: they are fetched per model from the providers' pricing pages and shown, dated, at the bottom. What the tool measures is who used it, how much was delivered, and what it consumed. This page joins the two, and never claims a saving: it tells you what the investment costs per unit of output, and what it would have to save to pay for itself.

panels.title: Seats — what you pay for against who uses it
Paid seats vs active users
panels.description: Seats is what you typed. Active users is measured: people with at least one verified AI-assisted commit in range. The gap between the bars is licence spend with no measured use behind it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS `Paid seats`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS `Active users`

panels.title: Seat utilisation
panels.description: Active users as a share of paid seats. Under 100% is seats nobody has used in range; over 100% means more people committed with assistance than you think you pay for — worth checking which.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100*(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL)/NULLIF(CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2)),0),0) AS value

panels.title: Spend per month
panels.description: Paid seats times cost per seat per month, both typed. The number every ratio below divides.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) AS value

panels.title: Per active user
panels.description: Monthly licence spend divided by active users. The real per-head price once unused seats are counted — the figure to compare against a seat's list price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL),0),0) AS value

panels.title: Unused seats / month
panels.description: Seats with no measured use in range, times cost per seat. Zero or negative means every seat was used. The one number on this page that is a saving you can actually make.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))-(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)),0) AS value

panels.title: Cost per unit of output — licence spend over the range, divided by what was delivered with assistance
Spend over the range
panels.description: Paid seats times cost per seat, times the months in the selected range. The numerator of every per-unit figure on this row — and, by construction, what any of them multiplied back by its count returns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))*(($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) / (30.4375*86400))),0) AS value

panels.title: What was delivered with assistance
panels.description: Commits with verified AI assistance in range, and closed issues with at least one such commit linked. The denominators of the per-unit figures beside them. Issues need tracker links; a range with none shows zero issues, which means unlinked, not undelivered.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted') AS `Assisted commits`,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
        JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
        WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
          AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND c.status='assisted') AS `Assisted issues closed`

panels.title: Per assisted commit
panels.description: Licence spend over the selected range divided by commits with verified AI assistance in it. Falls as adoption rises for the same spend.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))*(($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) / (30.4375*86400)))/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted'),0),2) AS value

panels.title: Per 1,000 assisted lines
panels.description: Licence spend over the range divided by lines changed in assisted commits, per thousand. Lines are output, not value — read beside the rework rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))*(($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) / (30.4375*86400)))/NULLIF((SELECT SUM(c.lines_added+c.lines_removed) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted')/1000,0),2) AS value

panels.title: Per assisted issue closed
panels.description: Licence spend over the range divided by issues resolved that had at least one assisted commit linked. Needs issue-commit links from the tracker; blank when there are none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))*(($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) / (30.4375*86400)))/NULLIF(n,0),2) AS value FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) n
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND c.status='assisted') t

panels.title: Per assisted commit, by month
panels.description: Monthly licence spend divided by that month's assisted commits, with the commit count behind it. The line should fall as adoption climbs; a month is skipped below 5 assisted commits.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9),'%Y-%m-01') AS DATETIME) AS time,
       ROUND((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))/NULLIF(SUM(c.status='assisted'),0),2) AS `Licence cost per assisted commit`,
       SUM(c.status='assisted') AS `Assisted commits`
FROM whodunit_commits c
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
GROUP BY time HAVING SUM(c.status='assisted') >= 5 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Break-even — what the tool would have to save to pay for itself
Hours per seat / month
panels.description: Cost per seat divided by the hourly rate, both typed. If a developer saves this many hours a month, the seat has paid for itself. Judge whether that is plausible — the page does not.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))/NULLIF(CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2)),0),1) AS value

panels.title: Hours per active user / month
panels.description: Total monthly spend divided by active users, then by the hourly rate. Higher than the per-seat figure whenever seats sit unused — the idle seats have to be earned back by the people who do use it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL),0)/NULLIF(CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2)),0),1) AS value

panels.title: Minutes per assisted commit
panels.description: Spend over the range, divided by assisted commits, converted to minutes at the hourly rate. Each assisted commit needs to have saved this long for the tool to break even.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(60*((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))*(($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) / (30.4375*86400)))/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted'),0)/NULLIF(CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2)),0),0) AS value

panels.title: Minutes per user / working day
panels.description: Monthly spend per active user at the hourly rate, spread over 21.7 working days. The daily saving each user needs to make. Small numbers here are the whole argument for the tool; large ones are the argument against.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(60*(CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL),0)/NULLIF(CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2)),0)/21.7,0) AS value

panels.title: ROI — conditional on what you believe about time returned
ROI by hours saved — pick the row you believe
panels.description: Return on licence spend if each active user saved the hours in the first column, every month, valued at the typed hourly rate. Nothing in this table is measured except the count of active users; the hours are the assumption, laid out so you can see which one you are making. The row where ROI crosses zero is the break-even figure above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hours AS `Hours saved per developer, per month`,
       ROUND(h.hours*CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL),0) AS `Value returned, per month`,
       ROUND((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) AS `Licence spend, per month`,
       ROUND(100*(h.hours*CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL) - (CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))))/NULLIF((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0),0) AS `ROI %`
FROM (SELECT 0.5 hours UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 8) h
ORDER BY h.hours

matcher.options: Hours saved per developer, per month

panels.title: ROI if the difference were time
panels.description: A hypothesis, not a measurement. Takes the conditioned output difference from the Productivity page, treats that share of each active user's typed working hours as time returned, values it at the hourly rate, and sets it against licence spend. The 'if' carries the weight: the difference is between self-selected cohorts and is not known to be time. Shown because it is the number people ask for, with its condition in the title.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pc AS (WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         c.contributor, c.committed_at
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
cell AS (
  SELECT purpose, band, status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY purpose, band, status
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT purpose, band,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM cell GROUP BY purpose, band
),
tot AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 'Pooled — all work' AS metric,
       ROUND(100*(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END)
                - MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END))
             / MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),0) AS value
FROM tot
UNION ALL
-- Weighted by the unassisted cohort's mix, so the strata are compared on a
-- common composition rather than each cohort's own.
SELECT 'Conditioned — like with like',
       ROUND(100*(SUM(a*nu)/SUM(nu) - SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)) / (SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)),0)
FROM pivot WHERE na >= 5 AND nu >= 5 AND u > 0)
SELECT ROUND(100*((pc.value/100)*CAST('$hours_per_month' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$hourly_rate' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor) FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL) - (CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))))/NULLIF((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0),0) AS value
FROM pc WHERE pc.metric LIKE 'Conditioned%'

panels.title: Implied hours / month
panels.description: The conditioned difference applied to the typed working hours per month — the hours-saved figure the hypothesis beside it rests on. Find this value in the sensitivity table to see what it assumes.

panels.title: Measured beside it, not converted — see the Productivity dashboard for the full argument
Pooled vs conditioned
panels.description: The same difference computed two ways. Pooled compares all assisted work against all unassisted work. Conditioned compares only like with like — same work type, same complexity band — and reweights onto a common mix. The gap between them is how much of the pooled figure was the mix of work each cohort picked up, rather than how productive it was. Neither is a verdict; both are differences between self-selected cohorts. Output here is lines delivered, not commits: inside a single work-type and complexity cell most contributor-days hold one commit, so a commit count pins both sides near 1 and measures the grid rather than the work.

panels.title: Rework rate, each side
panels.description: Share of commits whose purpose is a fix. A difference in output means nothing if it arrives with more rework, so read this before any row of the table. This is a fix RATE, not a defect rate — it counts commits labelled fix, not bugs found. Compares two measured cohorts only: commits with no evidence collected (undetermined, uninstrumented, unmatched, degraded) are excluded, not counted as unassisted — that would report absence as a measured negative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END AS metric,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.purpose='fix')/COUNT(*),1) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
  AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six statuses are named so this set stays complete as dun's list
    -- grows. Only two are compared: the other four mean no evidence was
    -- collected, and counting them as unassisted would report absence as a
    -- measured negative (NAV-21). CASE maps them to NULL, which drops them.
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY c.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

panels.title: Sessions not priced, and why
panels.description: Sessions excluded from the token figures, by reason: the agent reports no token counts, or the model it used has no row in the price table. Both are absence, not zero — an unpriced session is unmeasured, not free. A 'no price for' row means the price list needs a fetch or a new model has appeared.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT(s.agent, ' · ', CASE WHEN s.input_tokens IS NULL THEN 'reports no tokens'
                                   ELSE CONCAT('no price for ', COALESCE(NULLIF(s.model,''),'(no model)')) END) AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS value
FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND (s.input_tokens IS NULL OR p.model IS NULL)
GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Token spend at list price, per model — only meaningful if you are billed per token
Token spend in range
panels.description: Each session's tokens priced at its own model's list price — input, output, cache read and cache write each at that model's rate — summed over sessions with a price row. Prices come from the providers' pricing pages via fetch-model-prices.py, dated in the table beside. List price, not an invoice; under a subscription this is not a cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM((COALESCE(s.input_tokens,0)/1e6*p.input_usd + COALESCE(s.output_tokens,0)/1e6*p.output_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_read_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_write_usd)),2) AS value FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND p.model IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Token spend vs licence spend
panels.description: What the same usage would have cost at API list price, as a percentage of what the licences cost over the range. Over 100% says the subscription is cheaper than pay-per-token; under says the reverse.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100*SUM((COALESCE(s.input_tokens,0)/1e6*p.input_usd + COALESCE(s.output_tokens,0)/1e6*p.output_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_read_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_write_usd))/NULLIF(((CAST('$seats' AS DECIMAL(12,2))*CAST('$seat_cost' AS DECIMAL(12,2)))*(($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) / (30.4375*86400))),0),0) AS value FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND p.model IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Token spend by model, list price
panels.description: The same per-model pricing, split by model. Each bar is priced at that model's own rate, so the bars are comparable as money, not just as token counts. Models with no price row are absent here and listed in the unpriced panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.model AS metric, ROUND(SUM((COALESCE(s.input_tokens,0)/1e6*p.input_usd + COALESCE(s.output_tokens,0)/1e6*p.output_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_read_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_write_usd)),2) AS value FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND p.model IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.model ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Price list applied, per million tokens
panels.description: The list prices in use, for models seen in the selected range. Source 'fetched' means read from the provider's pricing page on the date shown; 'baked <date>' means the page could not be parsed and a dated snapshot was written instead. Rerun fetch-model-prices.py to refresh. A model missing here is unpriced, not free.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.model AS `Model`, p.provider AS `Provider`,
       p.input_usd AS `Input`, p.cache_read_usd AS `Cache read`, p.cache_write_usd AS `Cache write`, p.output_usd AS `Output`,
       CASE WHEN p.source LIKE 'http%' THEN 'fetched' ELSE p.source END AS `Source`,
       DATE_FORMAT(p.fetched_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS `As of`
FROM whodunit_model_prices p
WHERE p.model IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.model FROM whodunit_sessions s WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.model IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY p.provider, p.model

options.content: What this page does not claim. No time saved, no hours returned, no return-on-investment figure — none of those are measured, and a number built from an assumed hours-saved is an assumption wearing a chart. Token spend is shown at list price and only means anything if you are billed per token; under a subscription the marginal token costs nothing. Agents that report no tokens appear as unmeasured, not as free. The measured differences beside the break-even figures are between self-selected cohorts and are not effects.
